title: 西花园 Xi Huayuan
subtitle: a neighbouring imperial or princely garden · outside the walls · confidence A, assumed

model.line: Massing only, not a reconstruction: 118 plain blocks (walls, houses, halls), a tinted patch of ground. Its houses, rows and halls are generated to the kind of place, not drawn from a plan of it: assumed (C). The switch `around=0` hides everything outside the walls.

searched: No picture of it found in the catalogues searched for the surroundings.

facts.label: In English
facts.value: West Flower Garden (annex of 畅春园)

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a neighbouring imperial or princely garden outside the garden walls

facts.label: In 1860
facts.value: unknown; levelled to fields after 1860/1900 (S1201 lead); 'no longer exists' (S1203)

facts.label: Size
facts.value: polygon 34.4 ha (run), about 540 x 640 m by the proportions of Malone's sketch (S23), C; N and W sides uncertain (Malone)

facts.label: Where
facts.value: geo polygon, C: west of the C polygon of 畅春园, south wall in line with it, size by the proportions of Malone's sketch p.22 (S23); today's 海淀公园 (osm way 189801200) covers its south part (lead)

facts.label: Note
facts.value: S05 j78: 西花园在畅春园西, 南垣为进水闸, 水北流注于马厂诸渠; main hall 讨源书屋 five bays, 观德处; Qianlong held audience there when visiting his mother. Kangxi's heir 胤礽 (理密亲王) moved there (j76). Malone p.21-22: adjoined 畅春园 on the west; the cavalry ground lay north of it. Layout: 鲍润生 2024 (S1203) from Yangshi Lei drawings: not read.; Malone's sketch: 'West Flower Garden Gate' on the south side, the 'Imperial Stables' and a lake inside.
